XY series · PRC

Primal Clash

Released February 4, 2015 · 164 cards

Expanded

Primal Clash is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the XY series, released in English on February 4, 2015. Its main set has 160 cards, plus 4 secret rares numbered beyond the set (164 in total). It includes 133 Pokémon, 29 Trainer and 2 Energy cards, and is legal in the Expanded format (rotated out of Standard).

Illustrators

44 illustrators worked on Primal Clash. Most cards: 5ban Graphics (20), Ryo Ueda (11), Toyste Beach (8), Mitsuhiro Arita (7), Eske Yoshinob (6), Hitoshi Ariga (5), Kagemaru Himeno (5), match (5).
